info.title: smoothdev-web: a bird's-eye view of a Vite + Fable + .NET web app
info.description: Bird's-eye view of a Vite + Fable + .NET web app in development: dev server under dotnet watch, Vite and Fable, production server, dist packaging, logs and ports, from a terminal UI or a small web GUI.

commands.name: build
commands.description: compile once (dotnet build, Fable) to check the app builds

commands.name: config
commands.description: print the resolved config, how the file differs from detection, or write it

commands.name: dist
commands.description: production bundle into the client's dist (client.distCommand, or Fable then vite build)

commands.name: gui
commands.description:
web GUI served by the tool on 127.0.0.1; --detach runs it in the background
(tracked like the other components: `stop` or the GUI's own stop ends it)

commands.name: launches
commands.description:
every smoothdev-web launch on this machine: who started it (launcher, parent
processes), where, its ports and URLs; --all adds the ended ones

commands.name: open
others
commands.description:
other dev and web servers listening here that no launch holds (Vite, webpack,
Next, Nacara, dotnet watch, Fable, npm scripts, http.server, Jupyter...): folder,
kind, ports, URL, pid, age, who started it; --all adds the system's listeners

commands.name: site
commands.description: documentation sites (Nacara) under this folder, the Vite apps they host, and why

commands.name: dev
commands.description:
the site's dev server, each mounted Vite app under its base, one front port
site stop|status [--json]  stop / list what `site dev` and `site preview` started

commands.name: dist
commands.description: the site's build, with each mounted app built into its route (.smoothdev/web/site-dist)

commands.name: preview
commands.description: serve the site dist as a static host would

commands.name: status
commands.description:
components, state, PID, port, URL
dev start|stop|restart     dev server (dotnet watch --non-interactive), Fable watch, Vite; free ports picked
prod start|stop            dotnet publish -c Release, then run it (Production) serving the client's dist
preview start|stop         serve the client's dist as static files (what a static host serves)

commands.name: stop
commands.description:
stop everything this app runs
scan [tui|gui [--classic]] list Vite apps, Web SDK projects and smoothdev.web.json files under this folder;
tui and gui fold the folder tree and open an app with the same controls as `tui` or `gui` in that folder
tui or gui show hits as the walk finds them

commands.name: who
commands.description: the launch holding a port, else the process listening on it

options.name: --dir
options.description: the app folder (default: current folder; the nearest smoothdev.web.json above it wins)

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: print URLs instead of opening a browser (also SMOOTHDEV_WEB_NO_BROWSER=1)
